name: The Best Buffalo Chicken Dip (Easy & Cheesy)
description: This Easy Buffalo Chicken Dip is the best — creamy, spicy, perfectly melty, and loaded with tender rotisserie chicken. It’s simple to make, irresistibly delicious, and guaranteed to disappear at every game-day gathering.
recipeIngredient: 2 or 3 cups shredded chicken (we usually use rotisserie)
1 cup buffalo sauce (we usually use the primal kitchen brand)
1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese (regular or plant-based)
2 cups shredded cheddar cheese (regular or plant-based)

recipeInstructions.name: How To Make Easy Cheesy Buffalo Chicken Dip

itemListElement.text: In a medium saucepan, add your cream cheese, ranch dressing, and buffalo sauce and bring the contents to medium-low heat. Stir well and once fully combined, add your shredded chicken, 1/2 cup mozzarella, and 1 cup of cheddar cheese. Option to add more hot sauce, salt and pepper to taste.
itemListElement.name: In a medium saucepan, add your cream cheese, ranch dressing, and buffalo sauce and bring the contents to medium-low heat. Stir well and once fully combined, add your shredded chicken, 1/2 cup mozzarella, and 1 cup of cheddar cheese. Option to add more hot sauce, salt and pepper to taste.

itemListElement.text: Stir well and once the mixture is combined, add it to a small baking dish. Fold in green onions and top with the remaining cheese.
itemListElement.name: Stir well and once the mixture is combined, add it to a small baking dish. Fold in green onions and top with the remaining cheese.

itemListElement.text: Bake in the oven for 25 minutes or until the cheese on top is melted. Enjoy warm and top with more fresh green onions. We serve this with tortilla chips!
